claim_under_test: criterion (c): on R_COMP FREE (free-vocabulary, templated long rule sentences, gold trusted by construction), cross-family solver consensus c_score_align ranks unfaithful translations above faithful ones better than the incumbent cheap LLM judge (gemini-2.5-flash-lite, rubric A), in BOTH the disguised and the original view.
criterion_text: CONFIRMED iff, on the PRIMARY population, the within-template AUROC difference c_score_align - judge_cheap_disg AND c_score_align - judge_cheap_orig both have 95% percentile bootstrap CIs with lower bound > 0 (read once).
orientation: every score higher = more likely ERROR (judges: 1 - p(faithful))

labels.source: dataset-5 labeller resumed once (labeller/): exhaustive name-free map search (sealed, search-only hash 9609ebbb...) + gated two-checker gloss check (anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 + qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507, prompt gloss_v1 sha a2eecd66..., or ONE revision gloss_v2 if the half-A gate fails) + final seal
labels.binary: ERROR = ERROR_CERT or ERROR_GLOSS; CORRECT = CORRECT; EXCLUDED = READING_CHOICE, UNRESOLVED_*, UNPARSEABLE, NO_OUTPUT
labels.gate_pass_rule: BA >= 0.90 for haiku, qwen AND both_yes; both_yes recall_YES >= 0.85 and recall_NO >= 0.85 (as coded in gate.py); per-class recall < 0.85 reported and flagged, not gating
labels.firewall: labeller never imports confirm/ and never reads score files (labeller/tests/test_firewall.py); scores sealed first

populations.PRIMARY_P0_view: untouched (NOT seen_iter3) AND label_binary in {ERROR, CORRECT} AND c_score_align non-null AND the view's judge non-null; each paired delta is computed on its own view's P0 (P0_disg, P0_orig)
populations.judge_orig_column: judge_cheap_orig = exp-7 score where present, else the iter-5 label-blind completion with the byte-identical prompt (D16; 40/40 exp-7 cache-key regression hits); exp-7 json_parse failures stay missing
populations.untouched_definition: seen_iter3 from dataset-5 post_seal_join (row tier-A labelled CORRECT/ERROR in iteration 3); 2,198 untouched

testability_rule: TESTABLE iff P0 has >= 50 CORRECT and >= 50 ERROR rows, each class spread over >= 25 sentences; power adequate at >= 200 CORRECT (eval-3 power_E2.json rcomp_free: MDE80 ~0.11 at 200 CORRECT, ~0.10 at 400); the MDE of the scenario closest to the realised counts is reported next to the verdict. < 200 CORRECT -> flag 'underpowered'.

estimands.auroc_within_template: sum_t U_t / sum_t n_err_t * n_cor_t (ties 0.5), auc_tools.StratAUC copied verbatim from exp 7 (sha b0d058c9...)
estimands.paired_delta: AUROC_within(c_score_align) - AUROC_within(judge) on the SAME bootstrap weights

bootstrap.scheme: sentence-cluster bootstrap, sentences resampled with replacement WITHIN template (auc_tools.boot_weights, cluster stratum = template); a row inherits its sentence's multiplicity

metrics_scored: judge_local_orig (all null on FREE in exp 7: reported as coverage 0)
nested_spec: 5 sentence folds fold = int(sha1('rcomp_folds_v1|'+sentence_id),16) % 5; logistic regression (sklearn, C=1.0, lbfgs) fit on the train folds of P0_view, features rank-normalised within the train fold (test rows mapped by the train ECDF), OOF predictions for [judge_disg], [judge_disg + c_align], [judge_orig], [judge_orig + c_align], [c_align], [c_align + judge_disg]; report within-template AUROC deltas [j+c]-[j] and [c+j]-[c] with the sentence bootstrap over the fixed OOF predictions (no refit per replicate, disclosed); label-permutation null: 50 within-template label shuffles (seed 20260924), refit, report p95 of the null delta.
operating_point: exp-5 has no frozen c_score_align-only threshold (its thresholds are for fused models); reported: (i) the label-free majority rule c_score_align > 0.5 (= not END_MAJ), (ii) FA = 0.10 on CORRECT (descriptive, label-chosen); judge: p < 0.5 (score > 0.5) = UNFAITHFUL; recall, FA, precision with Wilson CIs

h_mech.i: among CORRECT candidates' non-agreeing peers (exact and ALIGN rules), share whose own label is ERROR / UNRESOLVED / UNPARSEABLE / NO_OUTPUT (peers are fewshot_v1 rows; unparseable peers are not in the matrix pool and are reported separately); bar >= 0.50 ERROR
h_mech.ii: SCATTER ratio SI_cor / SI_err via eval-2 mechanism.scatter_index unchanged; bar >= 2
h_mech.iii: NET delta(e+d) via eval-2 mechanism.net_test unchanged over word terciles W1<30 / W2<35 / W3; bar > 0
h_mech.iv: END_MAJ e and d under exact vs ALIGN, overall and by error type (ERROR_GLOSS = meaning-rename analogue; ERROR_CERT by dominant certificate type); prediction: ALIGN d lower AND e higher than exact; per item CONFIRMED / REFUTED

sensitivities.s1a: drop rows whose candidate matches any frozen s1 detector (all labels)
sensitivities.s1b: drop only ERROR_CERT rows matching the detectors (upper bound)

s1_detectors.d1_two_constants_same_slot: one predicate name with >= 2 distinct constants (non-bound-variable arguments) in the same argument slot
s1_detectors.d2_same_pred_disjunction: regex (?<![A-Za-z0-9_])([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\([^()]*\)\s*\)*\s*∨\s*\(*\s*¬?\s*\1\( (a disjunction of two atoms of the same predicate)
s1_detectors.d3_exists_under_forall_as_argument: the formula has a universal quantifier and an existential quantifier that introduces a variable used as a NON-FIRST argument of some atom (exists-for-constant)
s1_detectors.d4_negation_inside_name: a CamelCase / underscore token of a predicate name at a non-first position is one of doesnot|lacks|never|no|non|not|without

sensitivities.s2: UNRESOLVED_GLOSS as ERROR, then as CORRECT
sensitivities.s4: per template; ERROR vs CORRECT-weak and ERROR vs CORRECT-strong (matched_reading); READING_CHOICE excluded
sensitivities.s5: drop rows generated by the qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 slot (checker = generator)
sensitivities.s6: HAIKU-ONLY labels: gloss_decision re-derived with verdict = (haiku, haiku) for every pair ($0)
sensitivities.s8: primary with batch-incomplete sentences dropped (identical if no budget stop)
sensitivities.s9: orig view restricted to rows scored by exp 7 itself (no iter-5 completion)
sensitivities.s10: common support: rows where both judge views are non-null

audits.sig_e2e: 300 synonym-renamed SIG rows: false_CORRECT_on_known_ERROR bar <= 0.05; if it fails, (c) is reported with flag 'label soundness bar failed' and s6 is promoted to co-primary
audits.audit_ii: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, 60 ERROR_CERT + 60 CORRECT stratified by template (seed 20260924), PLUS (D14) +20 ERROR_GLOSS rows, PLUS the same rows through a second blind auditor from a disjoint family (z-ai/glm-4.6; fallback moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905), auditor-auditor kappa; precision per label class with Wilson CIs; an audit never changes a label

exploratory_holm.V4: only if the sibling freeze marker M1 provides frozen coefficients, else NOT_COMPUTED
exploratory_holm.variant_code: freeze_copy_prelim/consensus_variants.py (sibling experiment_14 draft, sha 6730a63b..., copied before labels); if M1 appears with a different sha the frozen code is ALSO scored and flagged
exploratory_holm.correction: Holm over the 8 two-sided bootstrap p-values

complexity: within-template AUROC and delta by word tercile and by nconds_weak; T3-T1 delta-of-deltas CI; same bootstrap
system_level: per slot x prompt_variant (12 systems): mean score vs ERROR rate, Kendall tau-b with sentence bootstrap CI; descriptive
coverage: scored share over all 2,652 FREE rows with UNPARSEABLE (188) and NO_OUTPUT (199) in the denominator; plus unparseable-as-ERROR row

budget.rule: each paid sweep is projected from a pilot before it starts; a sweep starts only if spent + projection <= 3.24 (mandatory) or <= 3.6 - 1.0 reserve for step F; FREE gloss runs in batches of 50 sentences ordered (not untouched, sha1('rcomp_confirm_v1|'+sentence_id)); a budget stop labels unfinished sentences UNRESOLVED_GLOSS_NOT_RUN and flags partial_budget

step_F_frontier: google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview original view, exp-7 rubric-A prompt verbatim, 150-row P0_orig stratified sample (75 ERROR / 75 CORRECT round-robin over templates, seed 20260924); only if remaining budget >= $1.00 after audits and a 5-row pilot projects within the remainder minus reserve

verdict_map.NOT_TESTABLE: P0 < 50 CORRECT or < 50 ERROR or < 25 sentences per class (either view)
verdict_map.NOT_CONFIRMED: otherwise (state which view failed and the point estimates)

deviations_declared_before_labels: D11 gloss.py HARD_STOP 3.6 + optional extra/usage_out args
D12 gloss_v2 (only if the gate fails)
D13 FREE gloss job order + 50-sentence batching
D15 c_exact recomputed from the eval-3 pair matrix (exp-7 c_score_sig is null on every FREE row)
D17 prereg freelab sha 05a5151e is the pre-D8 file; the running file = seal code_sha256 06e14f58
